name: Perphenazine enantate
summary: Perphenazine enanthate, sold under the brand name Trilafon Enantat among others, is a typical antipsychotic and a depot antipsychotic ester which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia and has been marketed in Europe. It is formulated in sesame oil and administered by intramuscular injection and acts as a long-lasting prodrug of perphenazine.

pharmacology.text: It is formulated in sesame oil and administered by intramuscular injection and acts as a long-lasting prodrug of perphenazine.

uses.text: Perphenazine enanthate, sold under the brand name Trilafon Enantat among others, is a typical antipsychotic and a depot antipsychotic ester which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia and has been marketed in Europe.
uses.brands: Decentan Depot, Peratsin Enantaatti, Trilafon, Trilafon Enantato, Trilafon Enantat, Trilifan Retard

sideEffects.en: Like other older antipsychotics it commonly causes stiffness, tremor and restlessness, along with drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, which is lasting involuntary movements, and there is a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity. A long-acting injection cannot be withdrawn quickly if problems appear.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他舊式抗精神病藥一樣，它常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖與躁動不安，並伴隨嗜睡與站起時頭暈。長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，也就是持久的不自主動作，另有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。長效注射劑若出現問題，無法迅速撤除。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他旧式抗精神病药一样，它常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖与躁动不安，并伴随嗜睡与站起时头晕。长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，也就是持久的不自主动作，另有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。长效注射剂若出现问题，无法迅速撤除。

fact.en: Enanthic acid is a seven-carbon fatty acid. Attached to the drug and dissolved in sesame oil, it forms a depot that releases the medicine slowly from the muscle.
fact.zh: 庚酸是七碳脂肪酸。它接在藥物上並溶於芝麻油中，形成長效劑型，從肌肉緩慢釋放藥物。
fact.zhHans: 庚酸是七碳脂肪酸。它接在药物上并溶于芝麻油中，形成长效剂型，从肌肉缓慢释放药物。
